title: When the Summer Falls
author: Paloma Nystrom
blurb: Odile Joubert, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
